L0.invariant: every L0 program leaves every slot dependent on at most one input position
L0.invariant_proof: induction over program length: SET_CONST clears the dependency set, COPY_INPUT sets it to one index, APPLY_UNARY is one-argument and leaves it unchanged; no operation reads two values, so the bound holds at any length and any budget

budget_arm_semantics: each repetition is a COMPLETE independent exhaustive search over Closure(L0); counters are never multiplied

development_task.stated_as: target behaviour only; no operation, primitive or program is named

extension_substrate_S.why_S_is_not_the_answer: S is lower level than L0, not a superset: it has no notion of a program over an input record, no sequencing against a task, and cannot be executed by the lineage at all unless a body is first registered as an L0 primitive. No micro-operation is a finished primitive, and a body must be assembled from several before it does anything.

m055_falsifier.statement: D019 closed M055 because the acquired expression was already inside the grammar closure: 737 candidates without the acquisition against 48 with it, making the search cheaper and nothing newly reachable
m055_falsifier.test: a primitive whose maximum source fanout is at most one cannot break L0's invariant and is therefore macro-reducible; the adopted primitive must exceed it
